A '''battle''' took place in the [[Charros system/Legends|Charros system]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3962 BBY]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. The Republic and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] clashed there during the latter group's campaign to take control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Called "[[Mandalorian Triumph]]," that charge was two-pronged, with one element that began in the [[Dernatine system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]&mdash;which they had [[Battle of the Dernatine system (Mandalorian Wars)|captured]] several years earlier&mdash;and continued through the Charros [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The Mandalorians were able to conquer the system during the battle. That part of their Coreward advance to Duro was later halted when Republic forces were able to [[Battle of the Randon system (Mandalorian Wars)|defend]] the [[Randon system/Legends|Randon system]] of the neighboring [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Charros system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
